lab: tools/mix_lab.py in a privileged container: 10 clients (own namespaces, kpclientd + http-proxy-client each) send HEAD requests at Poisson times (mean 30 s) to 30 live public websites, every one offering hybrid post-quantum TLS (3 per client); phase 1 through a Katzenpost mixnet (3 voting authorities, 3 mix layers, 1 gateway, 1 service node with the post-quantum-only fetch plugin, tools/kp_pq_fetch.py), phase 2 the same workload through a plain low-latency proxy (no mixing, no cover), as a multi-hop VPN's shared exit carries it
adversary: global passive: every client's link (send times only) and the service's internet link (each site's DNS lookup time); given the delay distribution (empirical from ground truth, and the network's own law: 5 Poisson hops at Mu); tools/gpa.py scores every client per request
sphinx_policy: Post-quantum on every layer: X-Wing (ML-KEM-768 + X25519) Sphinx and links, Ed25519 + SPHINCS+ directory signatures, fetches over TLS 1.3 with X25519MLKEM768 only; avpn mix refuses anything classical (tools/mix.py check_config, which the lab runs on its own network)
notes: Mix-lane accuracy 10.7% is within sampling noise of chance: 309 requests, 95% interval about +/-3.3 points around 10%.
The baseline attacker uses the same capture, grouping and scoring code, and identifies 88.2% of senders (the earlier run: 95.6%): the attack works where timing leaks.
Busy and idle send rates on the mix lane are equal (real-or-drop and loop cover); on the baseline a client's link is silent until it sends.
Failed live fetches: 502 (the reply exceeds one 8000-byte mixnet message, or the site refused) and 504 (no reply within 60 s).

Cost of the lane at these settings: median fetch latency 4.38 s (p90 6.47 s) against 1.66 s on the baseline, and about 555 kbit/s of upload per client, idle or busy (cover traffic). The post-quantum directory signatures and fetch plugin changed neither anonymity nor latency measurably against the earlier X-Wing run (11.6%, 4.26 s).

history_xwing_stock_proxy_ed25519_pki.sphinx_policy: X-Wing (ML-KEM-768 + X25519) at every hop; avpn mix refuses classical Sphinx

history_classical_sphinx.note: The same lab before the mix lane required post-quantum Sphinx (X25519 NIKE, 9,082-byte packets).
